volume_gain.note: Volume is not a network input. Apply this gain to the network output.

metadata.note: Channel 0 is audio; channels 1.. are the knob values in `knobs` order. Volume is not among them. Build that vector per audio sample and pass it to RTNeural::ModelT<float, N, 1, GRULayerT<float,N,H>, DenseT<float,H,1>>, then apply volume_gain.
